rule_description: Learner must have completed at least Phase 1 (DA-PH1 Foundations) or any subsequent phase to receive hackathon recommendations.
Learner must have completed at least Phase 1 (DA-PH1 Foundations) or any subsequent phase to receive data competition recommendations.
eBuddy recommends a small curated set of 4 to 6 events per interaction once unlocked (0 when locked).
Recommendation sets should mix hackathons and competitions where events are available in the upcoming window.
Filter out events whose scheduled end month is strictly prior to the current reference month (2026-11).
Prioritize events occurring within the next 1 to 4 months before recommending events further out in the season.
Boost IIT Bhubaneswar home campus events (Wissenaire, TechZephyr) for local learners.
Use skill_readiness_phase_derived as a soft recommendation hint to align events with learner's current or completed phase.
Mandatory fields in event recommendation card: event_name, category_track, expected_month_range, date_wording, last_held_month_range, eligibility_raw, mode_derived, skills_required_raw.
Explicitly display EXPECTED or TENTATIVE wording in event cards since source dates are forward-looking schedules.
Cap recommendations at a maximum of 2 events from the same organizer in any single recommendation set.
Filter out events whose restriction_flags_derived or eligibility_group conflicts with learner's institutional profile.
